'''Morrit Ch'gally''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and a [[Jedi recruiter|recruiter]] for the [[Acquisition Division]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Serving at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in the years preceding the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], Master Ch'gally was trained as a [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Sentinel]] and, among many other contributions to the Order, authored several chapters of the Temple guidebook titled ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. Writing down stories of his experiences as a Recruiter, Ch'gally passed on knowledge useful to the way young Jedi should present themselves to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biography==
Like most Jedi of the era, Master Ch'gally served the Order as a member of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] in the crusades against the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] known as the [[New Sith Wars]]. When the war ended, Ch'gally continued to study as a Sentinel, maintaining the role of [[Jedi investigator/Legends|investigator]]. Working intimately with the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the [[Analysis Rooms/Legends|Jedi Temple analysis wing]], Ch'gally would advise students on patience when it came to dealing with the computers there, as they provided answers only to those who thoughtfully requested them. As an investigator, Ch'gally gained experience with non-Jedi and he came to realise the uncomfortable truth that [[the Force/Legends|the force]] was limited in its applications. In ''The Jedi Path'', he advised readers to, in instances when the Force failed them, hand over the investigation to [[JN-66 analysis droid|JN-66 analysis droids]] and feel no shame in doing so. At some point, Ch'gally entered into work with the Acquisition Division and helped acquire several hundred [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] throughout his career. Some of these Initiates had already begun life outside the temple and struggled to adapt to the more ascetic Jedi way of life.<ref name="TJP" />

Master Ch'gally, while a believer in the Force, also stressed a reliance on one's own skills. He often claimed that focusing on combat training or studying the Force was good for fighting and debating, but to truly serve as guardians of civilization, one had to interact with the public and train in activities that lay people performed and could relate to.<ref name="TJP" />

When fellow Masters of the time proposed that a guidebook to the life of the Jedi be written, Master Ch'gally agreed to work on the project, authoring five chapters. Focusing on proper appearance and conduct that would best represent the Order, Ch'gally also touched on the necessity of being prepared while on a mission. Ch'gally had the privilege of detailing the aspects of being a Sentinel of the Order, as well as describing his profession as a recruiter for the Acquisition Division.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
While it did not make it into the finished edition, [[Daniel Wallace]], author of [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], released a list detailing the genders and species of each of the authors of the [[in-universe]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. Master Ch'gally is revealed to be a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="JCF" />
